chapter: Mamie Smith and the New York dance bands
title: Mamie Smith's theater circuit and TOBA
summary: The band played colored theaters in Cleveland, Detroit, Philadelphia, Baltimore and Washington on the TOBA circuit.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well now, Mamie Smith, where would she play? I mean where would you go?
We played all the different colored theaters like theaters, (unintelligible) in Cleveland, Detroit and Philadelphia. We were over to Baltimore, Washington.
